fin-lset.label: IPL death-overs strike rate of batters who arrived before over 11
fin-lset.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fin-lset.query: WITH entry AS (SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.over_num) eo FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id) SELECT CASE WHEN e.eo < 10 THEN 'arrived before over 11' WHEN e.eo < 15 THEN 'arrived overs 11–15' ELSE 'arrived overs 16–20' END band, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (6) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN entry e ON e.innings_id = d.innings_id AND e.pid = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 GROUP BY band, side

dbat-good-seasons.label: Seasons KKR scored faster than the league in the death overs
dbat-good-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dbat-good-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (6) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (6) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) team, SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (6) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

finb-lead-name.label: KKR's most-used batter in this phase, 2024–2026
finb-lead-name.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
finb-lead-name.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id = d.batter_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bnd, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 0 AND d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 15 AND 19 AND i.batting_team_id IN (6) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY d.batter_id HAVING balls >= 40 ORDER BY balls DESC LIMIT 8
